citation.title: Effects of different positive end-expiratory pressure titration strategies on mechanical power during ultraprotective ventilation in ARDS patients treated with veno-venous extracorporeal membrane oxygenation: A prospective interventional study

provenance.quote: Exclusion criteria for the study were age younger than 18 years, and end-stage chronic cardiopulmonary failure.
All patients were ventilated with an Engström Carescape™ R860 ventilator (GE Healthcare, Munich, Germany) in a volume-controlled mode with a VT of 3 mL/kg predicted body weight

in the intensive care unit (ICU) of the Department of Anesthesiology and Critical Care Medicine, University Medical Centre Mannheim, Medical Faculty Mannheim of the University of Heidelberg in Mannheim, Germany
Another dynamic recruitment maneuver was performed prior to ventilation with PEEP targeting an end-expiratory transpulmonary pressure of 0 cm H2O (PEEPPtpexp)
The primary endpoint was to investigate the effects of PEEP setting according to three different strategies on MP during ultraprotective ventilation in ARDS patients managed with V–V ECMO.
Twenty patients with severe ARDS treated with V–V ECMO were included in the analysis.
This prospective interventional study was conducted as part of a multipurpose study

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ARDS: all patients had severe ARDS per Berlin definition. Obesity: mean BMI 31.1 kg/m2 (≥30). Timing: intervention started during first 3 days of V-V ECMO; exact hours from ECMO start not reported, so unclear. Ptp target: PEEP titrated to end-expiratory transpulmonary pressure of 0 cmH2O (absolute subtraction suspected).

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: No overlapping reports identified. Trial registration DRKS00013967 unique. This study is a distinct VV-ECMO cohort; not overlapping with boesing_2022 (prone positioning study) based on different population and protocol.
unclear_items: Transpulmonary pressure computation method not explicitly stated; inferred as absolute subtraction (Paw - Pes).
Discrepancy in PEEP at PEEPPtpexp: abstract reports 17.3 ± 4.0 cmH2O, Table 2 reports 17.3 ± 4.7 cmH2O; recorded Table 2 value.
Timing from reference event: 'first three days of V–V ECMO treatment' - exact hours from ECMO start not reported, so timing_subgroup set to unclear.
Study is part of a multipurpose study (Graf 2022) possibly sharing patients; not in this review so overlap not checked.
extraction_flags.general_notes: Primary endpoint is mechanical power; within-patient crossover comparing three PEEP strategies in 20 severe ARDS patients on V-V ECMO.
